title: 插充电器：抓本体—测插脚/插孔框架—极性对齐—轴向插入到支撑
phases: Identify charger body, directed prongs and intended socket from current RGB.
Pick the body leaving prongs clear, then inspect actual carried pose.
Measure three directed prong/socket frame features from fresh RGB. Do not use object centers or an arbitrary gripper yaw as insertion orientation.
dock performs rigid feature alignment outside the socket, axial entry and advance to current visible seat (plug shoulder aligned with socket support); then release/retract.
Inspect seating and slip. Correct geometry/grasp after failure, rather than repeating the same unreachable orientation. Home only after supported release.
failure_lesson: Reference mate-pair preflight passed without verified seating; repeated plane-height measurements mostly failed. Explicit paired RGB features recovered measurements, not insertion.
reference_success_scope: External aggregate has native successes; cached detailed failure traces are not a reproduced successful charger controller.
